data.name: Beyond Captur
data.description: Beyond Captur is a South Korea-based direct air capture startup developing electrochemical, battery-based CO2 capture technology that runs entirely on electricity, avoiding thermal regeneration steps. The company signed a Definitive Agreement with Great Carbon Valley to pilot electrochemical DAC in Kenya.
